name: The Ectoplasmic Distiller

meta.previous: A Supernatural Device (Alliance), A Supernatural Device (Horde)

summary: Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan is working on his extra-dimensional ghost revealer but has run out of funds and manpower. The first piece he needs is an ectoplasmic distiller, and he asks you for a list of costly materials and forty gold to build it.

sections.title: What Mux Needs
sections.body: After A Supernatural Device, Mux Manascrambler welcomes your help with his ghost revealer, a machine meant to reach across dimensions. The first piece is a distiller, meant to gather the fabric of death itself, and he warns that building it will not be easy. He wants a delicate arcanite converter, four greater eternal essences, ten stonescale oil and twenty-five volcanic ash, plus forty gold. The ash is for a filter, and it must come from the lava pools of the Burning Steppes. Mux admits the materials are pricey, but swears every one will be needed.

sections.title: Mux's Thanks
sections.body: Mux says these are exactly the materials he needed, and that you arrived at a timely moment. He promises to have your distiller ready in moments and gives you something for your trouble.

faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris, who is building an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.
One delicate arcanite converter, four greater eternal essences, ten stonescale oil, twenty-five volcanic ash and forty gold.

faq.q: Where is the volcanic ash found?
faq.answer: Mux says to gather it at the lava pools of the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Why does Mux need these specific components?
faq.answer: They go into an ectoplasmic distiller, a device to gather the stuff death is made of. The volcanic ash is for building its filter.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the materials?
faq.answer: Hunting for Ectoplasm is the next step.
